title: Slack bot token stops working after 12 hours once token rotation is turned on
symptoms: token_expired from every Web API call about 12 hours after install
Refresh fails with invalid_refresh_token after reusing an old refresh token
Token rotation toggle cannot be switched back off
cause: With rotation on, access tokens expire after 43,200 seconds and each refresh returns a new single-use refresh token that replaces the old one. Rotation cannot be disabled once enabled.
fix: Store the new refresh token from every oauth.v2.access refresh, refresh before expires_in, and keep tokens in a shared database store with refreshes serialized so two workers never redeem the same token. Try rotation in a development app first.
apply:
r = client.oauth_v2_access(client_id=cid, client_secret=cs, grant_type="refresh_token", refresh_token=stored)
save(access=r["access_token"], refresh=r["refresh_token"], expires_at=now + r["expires_in"] - 300)
affected: Slack apps with token rotation enabled, as of 2026-10
